scope: First-block known-reference retrospective feature extraction. Keep current known_response_duration and original CPOP/LABS. No reference forecasts, report or second block.
method: Add independent local observed-data evidence to the adopted whole-trajectory method; rescue locations even when CPOP has no positive. Do not replace observations or classify isolated points as faults by rule.
reuse: Frozen 55-feature HGB state models15/31 from b1_known_weak_20261101, trained previously on5104 known development tasks. Standard sklearn, not a novel tree or new CPOP solver. New inference does not impose original-positive gate,20percent change cap or minimum segment duration.
seen_development: All earlier results are seen for this new version; development main panel is earlier functional test1872. New balanced validation precedes a separately frozen new final.
balanced_design: Each panel/seed/shape has all six amplitudes exactly once in independently shuffled order. No shape-amplitude alias. Same raw noise and anomaly variants per base.
physical_gate: Retain frozen adopted physical-change score>=0.025; any extra rejected true record is counted.
localization: Union adopted support mask with accepted local candidates, preserving already detected real short support. Candidate interval positions are explicit. No fitted-width-only short protection.
durations: Keep adopted direct duration estimates when already positive; when adopted effective duration was zero and independent local candidates exist, derive both durations from rescued state mask at the unchanged0.15kW/30s definitions. Model durations and localization mask remain explicitly separate quantities otherwise.

open_source_review.skchange: BSD3 official Github, moving-window candidates relevant but extra dependency and default change-point detector does not resolve this event/threshold task; inspect conceptual approach only.
open_source_review.sklearn: Installed1.7.2 BSD3 frozen HGB reuse; no install. Custom rescue/fusion compared as complete methods.

raw_channel: 50 raw-only multiscale features; exclude all CPOP and segmented-curve features. Existing reused point models failed to rescue physical short actions; failures kept.
scope_of_raw_rescue: Quiet task median absolute<=0.075kW and local observation<=0.35kW, with frozen physical gate; only adds candidate states, not removal or change of0.15 physical criterion.
rescue_strategy: Two-sided local pulse candidates1..60seconds, quiet flanks means within0.06kW, center mean0.15..0.35kW, noise-standardized contrast and independent raw classifier evidence. No minimum length; full short candidate interval supplied explicitly. Restrict targeted rescue to quiet task median<=0.075kW. Pointwise attempts retained as failed.
